purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for quality rules/profiles, validation executions/results, quarantine state, remediation candidates and post-remediation verification.

topics.name: DWH Data Quality Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for quality rules/profiles, validation executions/results, quarantine state, remediation candidates and post-remediation verification.

semantics.identity_rule: Rule, profile, validation execution, quality result, source revision, quarantine record and remediation candidate identities remain distinct.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing failures or suggested fixes grants no mutation/release authority.
semantics.action_rule: validate/quarantine/release/remediate/re-run operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.derived_rule: Quality score/status is displayed as derived evidence rather than canonical source truth.
semantics.redaction_rule: Sensitive violating values are redacted according to source governance.
semantics.graph_rule: Rule→target→result→remediation edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Unknown/not-evaluated, failed remediation and still-quarantined states remain explicit.

invariants.rule: Data-quality rules and results produce explicit evidence about exact data/schema identities; they never silently rewrite source data, change semantic ownership, declassify content or become authorization decisions.

hard_gates.condition: quality score shown as canonical truth
